# Experterna om Nvidias rapport: "Bra med tydlighet"

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-11-18  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The episode covers Nvidia's quarterly report, the first one presented by acting CEO Colette Kress after the scandal that forced Jensen Huang to step down. Revenue, EPS, gross margin (74.8%) and guidance all beat expectations, and next-year revenue growth guidance was raised to 75% from 70%. Redeye adviser Robin Berglund and co-guest Robert see the stock as cheap at about 11x forward 2027 P/E after a 35% drawdown and lean 'buy the dip'. They also expect AI hardware margins to come under heavy pressure and possibly turn to losses around 2029-2030, and they flag open questions about China exports, the SEC probe and CEO succession.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NVDA — Nvidia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Both guests are 'team buy the dip': strong report, raised guidance (+75% revenue growth), about 11x 2027 P/E after a 35% drawdown.

#### Reasoning

Fundamentally strong quarter, with gross margin above the company's own guidance and next-year revenue growth guidance raised from 70% to 75%. Robin and Robert see the valuation as low (about 11x forward P/E, about 8x EBIT) and expect margin compression only around 2029-2030. The CEO change is not seen as hurting near-term cash flow, and China is not a major worry for Robin. Conviction is tempered by margin, competition and governance risks.

#### Sell Triggers

- if gross margin falls sharply due to memory costs or competition
- if early signs of AI hardware overcapacity appear before 2029-2030
- if customers struggle to finance data centers
- if the SEC probe or China export investigations reveal wrongdoing

> *"Det är lockande att köpa Nvidia på de här nivåerna. Det håller jag med om. Om marginalen går ner 2030 är det relativt långsiktigt från 2026. Så jag är nog också lite mer team dipshop faktiskt."*

---

### ⛔ 000660 — SK Hynix | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Robert expects SK Hynix to make losses in a few years when the semiconductor cycle turns to overcapacity.

#### Reasoning

Robert compares semiconductors to car manufacturing: hype, then a bottleneck, then a big capacity build-out, then overcapacity. He is confident memory makers like SK Hynix will turn loss-making within a few years. The view is speculative and there is no explicit trade recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI demand keeps absorbing new memory capacity beyond 2030

> *"SK Hynix och Samsung tror jag absolut kommer att göra förlust."*

---

### ⛔ 005930 — Samsung | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Robert expects Samsung to make losses as the semiconductor cycle turns.

#### Reasoning

Same cyclical overcapacity thesis as for SK Hynix: memory and semiconductor makers face a bust after the AI build-out. This is a speculative long-term view with no explicit trade call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI demand keeps absorbing new memory capacity beyond 2030

> *"SK Hynix och Samsung tror jag absolut kommer att göra förlust."*
